thinkingMessage.text:
The investigation is complete. I am preparing the exact response with the mechanism, hub implementation path, and memo handler names.

The server pushes live events to browsers via SSE over `/api/v1/sse`. An in-memory pub/sub hub named `SSEHub` lives in `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go` and handles Subscribe, Unsubscribe, and Broadcast methods. The connection handler is in `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/sse_handler.go`. Five memo handlers directly invoke `s.SSEHub.Broadcast`: `CreateMemo`, `DeleteMemo`, `CreateMemoComment`, `UpsertMemoReaction`, and `DeleteMemoReaction`.

Three more memo handlers broadcast through the hub indirectly. `UpdateMemo`, `SetMemoAttachments`, and `SetMemoRelations` each call `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects`, which then invokes `SSEHub.Broadcast`.
